EEC: Initialism of European Economic Community, forerunner of the European Community (EC) and the European Union (EU).
EEF: To make a vocal rhythm in which some sounds are made by inhaling.
EEK: Representing a scream or shriek (especially in comic strips and books).
EEL: Any freshwater fish of the order Anguilliformes, which are elongated and resemble snakes.
EELAM: A proposed Tamil separatist state that would occupy northern and eastern parts of Sri Lanka.
EELERY: A place where eels are caught.
EELGRASS: Any of several species of aquatic plant, with very long and narrow leaves
EELLIKE: Resembling an eel in shape or behaviour.
EELPOUT: Any fish of the family Zoarcidae.
EELRIVER: A river in the United States:
EELS: Initialism of electron energy loss spectroscopy.
EELWORM: A nematode, or roundworm, especially any that resemble small eels and feed on plants.
EELY: Resembling an eel: long, thin and slippery.
EENT: Initialism of eyes, ears, nose and throat.
EEOC: Initialism of Equal Employment Opportunity Commission.
EEP: An expression of surprise or dismay.
EEPHUS: An off-speed pitch with unusually low velocity, intended to catch the hitter off guard.
EERIE: Inspiring fear, especially in a mysterious or shadowy way; strange, weird.
EEVEELUTION: Any Pokémon that is an evolution of Eevee, either official or made up by fans.
EEYORE: A talking donkey from the English children's book series Winnie-the-Pooh, noted for his melancholy and drowsiness.
